title: Bledsoe told that rockets fail because they carry weapons
summary: Chris Ramsay tells of Bledsoe told that rockets fail because they carry weapons, about 2007 onward at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and he asked uh are there weapons on them? And they said yeah and he goes that's why that's why it's not working. They don't want it to work.
That's what I'm saying. Every time they send one up, it attracts them and they'll come up and look at it if it has weapons on board.
tellings.difference: Credits Timothy Taylor and says the UFOs come up to look at every weapon-carrying launch, where the story says they make the rockets fail.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Bledsoe's account linking UFOs to rockets that carry weapons on board, with the weapons as what draws the UFOs' attention.

as_told.title: UFOs come to inspect rockets carrying weapons

plain: A YouTuber, Chris Ramsay, told podcast host Jesse Michels what he heard from Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he has had UFO encounters since around 2007: Bledsoe asked whether failed rockets carried weapons, was told yes, and said that is why they don't work, because "they" don't want them to. Bledsoe, telling it himself, credits a man named Timothy Taylor and says rather that the UFOs come up to look at every launch that has weapons on board. If true, someone not human would be keeping watch over weapons going into space.
